title: ReportHandoffDecisionTimeout
description: Sent in response to a Query Handoff Decision Timeout message.  The handoff decision timeout is the amount of time that must pass between this service requesting a handoff from the current controlling client and this service receiving a ConfirmReleaseControl message in response before that handoff request is considered failed due to a timeout.

HandoffDecisionTimeout.comment: The handoff decision timeout is the amount of time that must pass between this service requesting a handoff from the current controlling client and this service receiving a ConfirmReleaseControl message in response before that handoff request is considered failed due to a timeout.. A value of zero indicates this feature is disabled.
